name: Helical-Gear Trench
core_rationale: Southeastern spiral worm-gear canyon of Continent 02 where Krono the Brass Titan's threaded drive-shafts carve stepped helical ramps into the copper bedrock.
local_conflict: Spiral-thread construct beetles and oil-mist drakes patrol the rotating brass worm-shafts.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Unclutched bevel-pinion teeth spin at gale-force speeds across the northern Bevel-Pinion Overlook; Torque-Master Helix requires the Bronze Worm-Clutch Key before engaging the safety brake.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Spring-miners say that if you lock the bevel-clutch at Bevel-Pinion Overlook, a hidden brass escalator rises up the northern cliff wall.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A mile-long threaded brass worm-gear spinning slowly inside a terraced copper canyon.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What torque-engine chamber lies beyond Bevel-Pinion Overlook?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the southeastern drive-shaft trench of Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Mile-long threaded brass worm-gears spinning inside a terraced copper canyon.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 13.0m helical brass thread-ramps, 0.60m oil-gauge workbenches, and 0.14m cog-steps for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Complete 2x2 connected District matrix (hunting-area-spiral-wormway-ramp, town-helical-torque-hub, dungeon-worm-drive-gearbox, and Mystery hunting-area-bevel-pinion-overlook) with construct and reptile families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Promotes Helical-Gear Trench to Canon while preserving leaf Mystery frontier Bevel-Pinion Overlook behind a Fog of Lore portal.
